title: Coreference Resolution
motto: "She called him. He did not answer. The doctor was at lunch." Three references to two people and nobody is named. Coreference resolution figures out who is who.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: "She called him. He did not answer. The doctor was at lunch." Three references to two people and nobody is named. Coreference resolution figures out who is who.

steps.title: The problem
cards: Extract every mention of Apple Inc. from a 300-word article. Easy when the article says "Apple." Hard when it says "the company," "they," "Cupertino's technology giant," or "Jobs's firm." Without resolving these mentions to the same entity, your NER pipeline misses 60-80% of the mentions.

Coreference resolution links every expression that refers to the same real-world entity into one cluster. It is the glue between surface-level NLP (NER, parsing) and downstream semantics (IE, QA, summarization, KG).
